docs.text: LanDeng Open Datasets Machine-readable, link-worthy knowledge datasets for the LanDeng (澜灯) platform — Chinese botanical incense, documented in English with source transparency. Dataset File Status Ingredient database datasets/ingredients.json live (22 entities) Terminology database datasets/terminology.json live (104 terms, CC BY-SA 4.0) Aroma database datasets/aroma.json live (10 aroma families) Material database datasets/materials.json planned Comparison database datasets/comparisons.json planned All datasets use Schema.org Dataset + DefinedTerm structures. See Format & Governance .
